versions.subject: Updating id
versions.detection:
selection1:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\wscript.exe'
        - '\cscript.exe'
    TargetFilename|startswith: 
        - 'C:\Users\'
        - 'C:\ProgramData'
    TargetFilename|endswith: 
        - '.jse'
        - '.vbe'
        - '.js'
        - '.vba'
        - '.vbs'
condition: 1 of selection*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\wscript.exe", "*\\cscript.exe") TargetFilename IN ("C:\\Users\\*", "C:\\ProgramData*") TargetFilename IN ("*.jse", "*.vbe", "*.js", "*.vba", "*.vbs")
